seo.title: handover | Universal AI Chat to Coding Agent Handoffs
seo.description: Turn exported AI chats into agent-ready project context for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Aider, Goose, and more without re-explaining the work.

hero.tagline: Design in any AI chat. Build with any coding agent. Zero context lost.
hero.subhead: handover converts exported AI conversations into durable project context, structured plans, and agent-specific files so implementation can start immediately in the tool you already use.

demo.title: See the handoff before anything gets written.
demo.description: The CLI can preview exactly what it will extract from a chat and which files it will generate, so contributors understand the outcome before they touch a project directory.
lines: Goal       : Build a FastAPI REST API with JWT auth and PostgreSQL
Tech Stack : Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pytest

howItWorks.title: A short path from design chat to working code.
howItWorks.description: handover stays focused on the moment teams lose context most often: moving from exploratory chat into a coding session that needs concrete files, constraints, and next steps.

steps.title: Export the conversation
steps.description: Pull a JSON, JSONL, or markdown chat export from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Perplexity.

steps.title: Run handover locally
steps.description: Generate a universal .handover knowledge base plus the target-specific files your coding agent expects.

steps.title: Open your coding agent
steps.description: Start in Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Aider, Goose, or another target with the work already framed.

integrations.title: Every source and target stays on equal footing.
integrations.description: handover is not a Claude-only wrapper. It reads multiple chat export formats and emits multiple agent-specific outputs from the same extracted context.

artifacts.title: One universal memory layer, plus the exact files each agent expects.
artifacts.description: The generated structure keeps core project understanding portable while still fitting naturally into whichever coding agent a contributor prefers.

quickstart.title: Install it, export a chat, run the handoff.
quickstart.description: The first website release keeps the on-ramp intentionally short so contributors can understand the tool in one screen and try it in one terminal session.
lines: # Export a chat as JSON, JSONL, or markdown from your AI tool

footer.blurb: Static Astro site for the open-source handover CLI, synced from the main project repo and deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
